title: qwen-code
intro: Qwen Code, headless over `qwen -o stream-json`, on an OpenAI chat-shaped provider through `OPENAI_BASE_URL`, `OPENAI_API_KEY` and `OPENAI_MODEL`.
notes: The session id is derived from the platform's session id as a UUID: `--session-id` on the first turn, `--resume` after.
Stdin is read into the prompt, so the CLI is run with `</dev/null` and the prompt as an argument.
`--auth-type openai` with a `/v1` base; `openai-responses` is also accepted for an OpenAI Responses provider.
